model_family.description: Model family. Supported native ms-swift families and custom families.

model_path.description: Path to model weights. If empty, inferred from model_family.

base_model_path.description: Path to an official/base checkpoint to copy config, tokenizer, and processor files from.

component_paths.description: Per-component initialization sources. Keys are component names (e.g. language_model, aligner, vision_tower, generator). Values are a path string or the literal 'random'.

additionalProperties.description: Path to component checkpoint weights, or the literal 'random' to keep random initialization.

component_trainable.description: Per-component train/freeze strategy. Keys are component names (language_model, vision_tower, aligner, generator) or the pseudo-component 'text_head'. Values are boolean (true=train, false=freeze).

additionalProperties.description: Whether this component should be trainable.

additional_trainable_parameters.description: Optional additional parameter name prefixes to keep trainable when their parent component is frozen. Use only when the automatic text_head resolution is insufficient.

whisper_path.description: Path to whisper model (for custom audio models like kimi_audio/mimo_audio).

source_code_url.description: Local path or URL to model source code. Required for custom models; optional for registered models.

paper_url.description: Local path or URL to paper. Required for custom models; optional for registered models.

max_gpus.description: Maximum number of GPUs to use for training.
